A code cleanup with no visible changes. Install it over 1.0.9; your data stays.

**[Download Spectra.apk](https://github.com/m0n0t0ne0ne/spectra/releases/download/v1.0.10/Spectra.apk)**

### Under the hood
- Removed the old photo barcode reader and an old quick-add button handler, which no screen could reach anymore.
- Insights now uses the same calorie target as the Diary, so the two always agree.
- Workout calories are added up in one place instead of three.
